title: Games with Incomplete Information Played by Risk-Revising Players
summary: This paper introduces risk-revising players to a class of games with incomplete information. These players enter the game with ex ante risk preferences represented by coherent risk measures and develop time-consistent interim revisions of them contingent on their private information. The standard Nash equilibrium at ex ante stage and Bayesian Nash equilibrium at interim stage are extended to their risk-averse counterparts.
